schema.spans:
CREATE TABLE traceforge.spans
(
    `trace_id` FixedString(32),
    `span_id` FixedString(16),
    `parent_span_id` String,
    `service_name` LowCardinality(String),
    `span_name` String,
    `span_kind` UInt8,
    `start_time` DateTime64(9, 'UTC'),
    `end_time` DateTime64(9, 'UTC'),
    `duration_ns` UInt64,
    `status_code` UInt8,
    `status_message` String,
    `resource_attributes_json` String,
    `span_attributes_json` String,
    `scope_name` String,
    `scope_version` String,
    `events_json` String,
    `links_json` String,
    `resource_json` String,
    `scope_json` String,
    `span_json` String,
    `resource_schema_url` String,
    `scope_schema_url` String,
    `ingested_at` DateTime64(3, 'UTC') DEFAULT now64(3)
)
ENGINE = MergeTree
PARTITION BY toYYYYMM(start_time)
ORDER BY (trace_id, start_time, span_id)
SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192
schema.logs:
CREATE TABLE traceforge.logs
(
    `log_id` FixedString(32),
    `source_event_id` String,
    `trace_id` String,
    `span_id` String,
    `trace_flags` UInt32,
    `service_name` LowCardinality(String),
    `severity_number` UInt8,
    `severity_text` String,
    `event_time` Nullable(DateTime64(9, 'UTC')),
    `observed_time` Nullable(DateTime64(9, 'UTC')),
    `effective_time` DateTime64(9, 'UTC'),
    `time_source` LowCardinality(String),
    `body_text` String,
    `body_json` String,
    `attributes_json` String,
    `resource_attributes_json` String,
    `scope_name` String,
    `scope_version` String,
    `event_name` String,
    `resource_json` String,
    `scope_json` String,
    `record_json` String,
    `resource_schema_url` String,
    `scope_schema_url` String,
    `ingested_at` DateTime64(9, 'UTC'),
    INDEX s13_trace_bloom trace_id TYPE bloom_filter(0.01) GRANULARITY 1
)
ENGINE = MergeTree
PARTITION BY toYYYYMM(effective_time)
ORDER BY (effective_time, log_id)
SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192
schema.metric_points:
CREATE TABLE traceforge.metric_points
(
    `stream_id` String,
    `metric_name` String,
    `service_name` String,
    `service_namespace` String,
    `end_ns` UInt64,
    `start_ns` UInt64,
    `point_json` String,
    `ingested_at` DateTime64(9, 'UTC') DEFAULT now64(9)
)
ENGINE = MergeTree
PARTITION BY toYYYYMM(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(toInt64(end_ns), 'UTC'))
ORDER BY (metric_name, service_name, stream_id, end_ns)
SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192
